kept.excerpt: Real Madrid C. F. and Vini Jr. agreed to extend the player's contract until June 30, 2027.
kept.relevance: The club's official announcement establishes a contractual commitment extending beyond the market's September 2026 deadline.

kept.excerpt: AS reported that Vinicius had decided to remain at Real Madrid for the next season even if he did not renew his contract. The report said he would otherwise run down his existing agreement, which expires on June 30, 2027, and that renewal negotiations had stalled.
kept.relevance: This report directly addresses his willingness to stay through the 2026 summer transfer window despite unresolved renewal talks.

kept.excerpt: AS reported that Real Madrid and Vinicius had arranged renewal discussions for the final days of July, before preseason began. Both the player and club officials had communicated their intention to reach an agreement extending his contract and keeping him at Madrid.
kept.relevance: The planned late-July negotiations and stated mutual desire for continuity identify an imminent catalyst relevant to whether he stays.

kept.excerpt: The Guardian reported that Arsenal's potential move for Vinicius was at a formative stage.
kept.relevance: Credible reporting on the cutoff date identifies an interested acquiring club while indicating that a transfer remained preliminary.

kept.excerpt: Citing The Athletic, Cadena SER reported that Arsenal would pursue Vinicius if he did not renew with Real Madrid. The reproduced David Ornstein report described Arsenal's interest as early stage, approved internally at all levels, with no club-to-club talks yet. Cadena SER said Vinicius was expected back at Valdebebas the following Monday, when renewal discussions were expected to resume.
kept.relevance: This cutoff-date report connects Arsenal's conditional interest to the unresolved renewal and provides the expected timing of the next talks.

kept.excerpt: Arseblog reported that The Athletic's David Ornstein had identified Arsenal's interest in Vinicius should he decide against extending his Madrid contract. It noted that he had 12 months left on his existing agreement and that a transfer would require a substantial commitment in both fee and salary.
kept.relevance: This contemporary specialist account highlights the conditional nature of the approach and financial obstacles to completing a move.

search_notes: Frozen cutoff: 2026-07-25. Included only sources with explicitly verifiable publication dates on or before that date; Spanish excerpts are factual English paraphrases. Later-dated search results, undated live profiles, and betting or prediction-market pages were excluded. The Guardian article's displayed publication and modification dates were both July 25, 2026. Several July 25 accounts derive from the same Athletic/Ornstein report and should not be treated as independent confirmation. web_fetch failed because of a provider-configuration error; the requested agent-reach web-read fallback returned RATE_LIMITED and was not retried.
